Ukrainian drone strikes cause fuel crisis in Russia

Ukraine has conducted drone attacks targeting Russian oil refineries, leading to a significant fuel shortage within Russia. This has resulted in rationing, queues at petrol stations, and rising prices, impacting citizens and businesses. Russian President Putin has acknowledged the issue.
